description: List secret keys and metadata (NEVER values). Optionally filter by tag.
embedding_description: Vault: list stored secrets — metadata only, NEVER values. Enumerates keys + tags + metadata + version of every credential / password / OAuth client_secret / API key / refresh+bearer token. Does NOT require unlocking (metadata is unencrypted). Optional tag filter narrows the subset. Use to inventory credentials the solet holds.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: List of secret metadata. Contains secrets (array of records with key, tags, metadata, version) and count (total number). NEVER contains secret values.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Lists secret keys and metadata from the vault. Does not require vault to be unlocked (metadata is not encrypted).
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: VaultNotInitialized: Vault has not been set up yet. StorageError: Unable to read from vault storage backend.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For VaultNotInitialized: Guide user through vault initialization. For StorageError: Check storage backend health and permissions.
